Details
  • Paper: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks, NeurIPS 2012, 2012-12-03
  • Original code: https://github.com/pytorch/vision at 1f1a920d685d
  • Authors' code, not used: https://code.google.com/archive/p/cuda-convnet/ (cuda-convnet (C++/CUDA)): The authors' cuda-convnet code is obsolete; torchvision's PyTorch AlexNet carries usable ImageNet weights.
  • Code licence: BSD-3-Clause (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: BSD-3-Clause (assumed from code)
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/pytorch/vision/blob/1f1a920d685d46dfbe187934b785b7ecb7a182f2/LICENSE
  • Training data: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: alexnet.tv_in1k (default of alexnet)
  • Outputs: logits; label_set: imagenet-1k
  • Input size: fixed 224x224: the input is resized (short side 256) and centre-cropped to it
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): alexnet.tv_in1k 224x224 (0.1 GiB peak allocated, 0.3 reserved)
  • alexnet.tv_in1k 224x224, first call: portable + torch.compile 4 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 13 s (ONNX + engine).
  • alexnet.tv_in1k original 224x224: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • alexnet.tv_in1k load / first call: original 2.51 s / 0.811 s, portable 1.3 s / 0.016 s, kernels 1.4 s / 0.055 s
  • Protocol, median of 9 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input (synthetic for bench_inputs sizes), card defaults; gc before each load; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls

Measured

fastforks: the model's own resize / crop on the GPU; original: the library's pretrained loader and its PIL eval transform. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
